quote.text: Spectators will have the opportunity to watch most of the competition.
quote.original_text: Lookers-on see most of the game

translations.text: 観客は試合のほとんどを見ることができる
Watazamaji wanaweza kutazama sehemu kubwa ya mechi.
მაყურებლებს მატჩის უმეტესი ნაწილის ყურება შეეძლებათ.
Yleisö pääsee seuraamaan suurimman osan ottelusta.
观众将能够观看大部分比赛。
Ikusleek partida gehienak ikusteko aukera izango dute.
Hanana fahafahana hijery ny ankamaroan'ny lalao ny mpijery.
ผู้ชมจะมีโอกาสได้ชมการแข่งขันส่วนใหญ่
Spectators will have the opportunity to watch most of the competition.
